opennyai_summary.arguments:
Learned counsel appearing for the appellant/applicant submits that the appellant/applicant was about 22 years of age and believing the victim to be more than 18 years of age, performed the marriage with her in a temple.
He further states that though the prosecution has later alleged the Arun vs State Nct Of Delhi on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82771455/
1 victim to be of 12 years of age, however failed to prove the same.
In this regard, he has placed reliance on the decisions in Saudan Singh vs. The State of Uttar Pradesh reported as 2021 SCC OnLine SC 3259 and Sonadhar vs. The State of Chhattisgarh reported as 2021 SCC OnLine SC 3182.
4.
The application is opposed by learned APP appearing for the State duly assisted by learned counsel appearing for the victim to submit that the marriage performed by the appellant is no marriage in the eyes of law and that the victim was a minor at the relevant time.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: 6. As per the interaction form and the nominal roll on record, it is noted that the appellant has undergone more than half his sentence.

7. (i) In case of change of residential address, the appellant shall promptly inform the same to the concerned Investigating Officer as well as to this Court.
( ii) The appellant shall regularly appear before the Court as and when the appeal is taken up for hearing.
(iii) The appellant will not get in touch directly or indirectly with the victim.
(iv) The appellant shall also provider his contact number to the IO and shall remain available on that number.
8. With the above directions, the application is disposed of.
